phase1_rulings.R-1_OPERATOR_s7_three_regimes: S-7 has THREE regimes, not two. Operator-ruled 2026-08-06 after the vertical measurement, because the charter's 'a 120-col fallback is required' is an operator-approved clause and the counterexample re-opens it CONSTRUCTIVELY - the requirement comes out larger, not deleted. (1) At/above the wide breakpoint (_DIFF_WIDE_MIN = 139, content units): run list beside full-width windows. (2) At 120: the list becomes an OVERLAY on a dedicated key, the window takes full width, and the 2 visible hex rows are an explicitly-accepted paginable viewport. (3) Below the threshold where even that fails: an EXPLICIT NOTICE naming the required width/height, instead of the silently empty panel shown today. The notice regime is entered on HEIGHT as well as width - that is the whole finding - so its threshold must be DERIVED as a normative allocation bound over the measured vertical budget, never hand-picked. Closes the architect's OQ-1.
